dataclass_replace.label: dataclasses.replace() per event
dataclass_replace.why: Extension. Full field re-construction of a frozen event to change one field.

decimal_arithmetic.label: Decimal() construction
decimal_arithmetic.why: Extension, and NOT prohibited -- declared allowed. Money is Decimal end to end and that is what makes P&L reductions order-free (Phase 1 budget row 4).

deep_copy.label: copy.copy / copy.deepcopy
deep_copy.why: Extension. Unbounded in the size of the copied graph.

disk_io.label: filesystem read/write/stat/glob
disk_io.why: P4-named. Unbounded, host-dependent latency inside a synchronous dispatch that has no queue to absorb it.

dynamic_dispatch.label: getattr / hasattr / setattr / vars / deferred import
dynamic_dispatch.why: P4-named. Name-resolved dispatch defeats the type-level contract and makes an absent attribute a silent no-op rather than an error.

governance_evaluation.label: reference to promotion / lifecycle / gate-matrix machinery
governance_evaluation.why: P4-named and CORE C.10. Whether an alpha is live is resolved at composition and must never be re-evaluated per event.

logging_with_formatting.label: logging call that formats or interpolates
logging_with_formatting.why: P4-named. Builds a message and an args tuple per event even when the level is disabled, unless the call is guarded.

per_event_dict_construction.label: dict literal / dict comprehension / dict() per event
per_event_dict_construction.why: P4-named. Allocation per event; feeds the GC the harness has to disable to keep latency stable.

per_event_set_construction.label: set literal / set comprehension / set() / frozenset() per event
per_event_set_construction.why: Extension. Allocation plus, per Phase 1 budget row 3, a hash-ordered iteration whose order is seed-dependent.

regex.label: re.compile / match / search / sub / findall
regex.why: Extension. Pattern work per event, usually on a string that was itself built per event.

serialization.label: json / pickle / hashing / encode / asdict
serialization.why: P4-named. Cost is proportional to payload size and is only ever needed off the decision path.

sorting.label: sorted() / list.sort() per event
sorting.why: Extension. O(n log n) per event; also the determinism neutralizer for rows 2a/3, so it may not simply be deleted -- it must move to the producer.

string_formatting.label: f-string, %-format, .format(), .join() outside a logging call
string_formatting.why: Extension. Builds a string per event for a value that is usually discarded; the correlation-id and reason-tuple paths are the measured carriers.

transcendental.label: math.log / exp / sqrt / pow and friends
transcendental.why: Extension, and NOT prohibited -- declared allowed with a stated cost, because Phase 1 row 12a makes libm the reason whole-platform parity is host-local. Counted so the allow list is honest.

wall_clock_read.label: time.* / datetime.now on the tick path
wall_clock_read.why: Extension. Phase 1 budget row 7: the allowlist is file-granular, so a call-granular census is the only way to know the real count.
